base_selection_rule.return_to_v111_base: Keep V111 as clean champion when V113 has any unresolved Hard Safety Failure or a major-family regression.
base_selection_rule.dual_champion_candidates: Allowed only if safety passes and strength is unresolved.

preregistered_dual_benchmark.v114_authorization: None. A repeated executable loss regime and preregistered Targeted Efficacy experiment are still required.
